test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A tailor can make 5 pieces out of 1 m of cloth. He has 57.6 m of cloth. How many pieces can he make out of this cloth?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of cloth required to make 5 pieces = 1 m

Length of cloth available = 57.6 m

**Calculation:**

⇒ In 1 m cloth, the number of pieces made = 5

⇒ In 57.6 m cloth, number of pieces made = 57.6 × 5 = 288 pieces

**Therefore, 288 pieces can be made out of cloth.**
